dialogues.speaker: Ritou Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This Ritou bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices regarding all kinds of matters will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Notice
dialogues.text: A number of suspicious outlanders have entered Inazuma lately, wandering around with seemingly sinister motives.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Notice
dialogues.text: The Shogunate hereby notifies everyone: those who report suspicious persons will be rewarded, while those who harbor them will be punished!

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Notice
dialogues.text: Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting reign!

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: The Vision Hunt Decree operation is coming to an end, but those who conceal their Visions still remain.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Following the orders of the Tenryou Commissioner, and in compliance with the command of Madam Kujou Sara, pursuit operations will avoid using force or disrupting the public as much as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Please don't worry. The Tenryou Commission will not use its public duties as an excuse to intrude on your daily lives.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commissioner guarantees this in his own name, and that of the Kujou Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The Supreme" Itto
dialogues.text: "Kujou Tengu! I've arrived at Ritou! Stop harassing outlanders all the time!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The Supreme" Itto
dialogues.text: "Don't you ever forget the beating that you gave me!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The Supreme" Itto
dialogues.text: "You cannot escape our rematch, you hear me?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Ugh! Can you stop vandalizing these boards everywhere you go? You keep talking about the same thing every time, too!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: If you want your rematch so much, come at me, then! Forget appearances or whatever... once this war is over, I will grant you your wish!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: So just knock it off already! If I wasn't an officer of the Kujou Clan, I would have sued you for harassment already!

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "Though this is not a serious matter, I still hope that it will become more common knowledge."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "The other day, I accidentally lost the only extant copy of the famous 'Toki Alley Tales,' written by Takizawa Kyouden."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "Though it's nothing major, Lady Yae still insisted that I post a lost book notice to look for it. Ah, what a headache..."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "That poor book has probably had its pages scattered to the winds by now... I don't suppose it would be possible to find it at this point."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "It really is nothing of note, but if anyone could help recover it, you will have the Yae Publishing House's thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: All outlanders seeking to enter Ritou while the Sakoku Decree is in effect must provide valid documentation or they will be prohibited from landing.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Prohibited items are not allowed in Ritou. Weapons, camping gear and foreign specialties must be registered for taxation.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Please take care of your documentation and personal identification. They will not be replaced if lost!

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Anyone who has been in contact with the Sangonomiya must be put under surveillance in Ritou for one year and will not be allowed to leave.

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "Outlander merchants, if you are facing any issues or difficulties in Ritou,"

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "Come find Mr. Kurisu at the International Trade Association. We will do our best to help you!"

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "If there is anything that you don't understand or that troubles you, come look for us."

dialogues.speaker: International Trade Association Notice
dialogues.text: "The International Trade Association's doors are always open to outlanders from any nation."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Chiba Hanako, Chiba Ryuuichi, former workers at the Jakotsu Mine, technically certified, healthy, hard-working."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looking for a job to pay for daily family expenses. We hope to work in the same place together."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Salary and benefits negotiable!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Higi Kai, former technician at Tatarasuna, technically certified, experienced in management, healthy."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looking for a job to feed my family. Salary and benefits negotiable."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Nonomura Yuuya, former worker at Tatarasuna, healthy, hard-working, suitable for high risk positions!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looking to have a stable job until the war ends."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Salary and benefits negotiable. Would like to have regular rest time!"

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Many workers have come to Ritou to look for employment after Tatarasuna was shut down.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: The Kanjou Commissioner will help everyone find a job. Please do not post any advertisements, as they will affect the image of the city.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Note that all job hunting advertisements will soon be taken down throughout Ritou.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: The shutdown problem was taken care of recently. Most workers have found re-employment at the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: To prevent crime, those who refuse to accept job placements will be transferred to a central temporary holding location and prohibited from going outside.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: There might be another round of merchant ships arriving in Ritou from Snezhnaya soon. Everyone at the harbor, please prepare for their arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: As a gesture of support, merchants from Snezhnaya may enjoy partial tariff reduction or exemptions.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: As for Snezhnayan merchants currently residing in Ritou, please renew your documentation at the Kanjou Commission headquarters at your first convenience,

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: So as to avoid any inconvenience in your residential, travel, or business affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Bounty: Yoshino Koheiji, Yoshino Koheita

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Crimes committed: Absconding, robbery, night-time assaults, conspiring against officials, distributing belongings to innocent villagers to incite rebellion.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Wanted dead or alive with a generous bounty!

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Bounty: Midorikawa Shirou

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Crimes committed: Absconding, riotous assembly, piracy, robbing officials, ambushing samurai, holding family members as hostages in an attempt to rebel against the Shogunate.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: This person and his accomplices are wanted dead or alive with a generous bounty!

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: With the permission of Guuji Yae Miko, the Grand Narukami Shrine will provide help to those businesses and families affected by the war in the form of aid loans and food aid.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: We ask that those in need of help please visit the Kamisato Clan to file the required paperwork.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: (Outlanders with valid documentation will also receive some form of subsidy.)

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: As the war continues and public funds become more tight, food aid will be reduced by half. We apologize for any inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'd like to thank Lady Yae Miko and the Yashiro Commissioner for their good intentions. The problem is that the documentation approval process takes way too long..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "By the time the documentation is approved, all of the food aid will have been given out... this is really inconvenient for us outlanders."

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: We are sorry to hear that. We will take your feedback into careful consideration.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: As the war continues and public funds become more tight, we hope the outlander merchants will be generous enough to donate and help the authorities out.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: To this effect, the Kanjou Commission has decided to increase the retail space rental fee five-fold. Thank you for your understanding.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hmph, we've helped the authorities out alright, but who will help us?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Although we truly hope the war will end soon..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "At the same time, the dock at Ritou has become a lot more active thanks to this war."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Although our workload has increased by a lot, so have our wages."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Seeing my wife working so hard at the dock, seeing my kids looking forward to another good meal..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I suppose I should support the continuation of this war after all."
